text:
Maria: Heads up — pricing-experiment promo got reversed mid-month and the vendor invoice came later than expected. Need guidance on deferral vs accrual for month-end close. Total vendor credit ~ $42,300. Anyone from revrec available?

Ajay: Are these partner-funded credits or internal discounts?

Maria: Partner-funded (CloudRack). Quick breakdown pasted below — applied to accounts A/B/C, reversal happened 2024-11-20, vendor invoice received 2024-11-22. We already recognized revenue for ~8 invoices.
```
acct_A - $18,450 - committed subscription
acct_B - $12,300 - usage-based
acct_C - $11,550 - committed subscription
TOTAL - $42,300
```

Noah: If vendor reimburses, standard is to record a vendor liability accrual and offset revenue. For close I suggest: 1) Accrue vendor payable (GL 2200) for expected reimbursement 2) Adjust revenue deferral (GL 2100) to reverse amounts on affected invoices. How many invoices exactly? Note: >$25k needs Finance lead sign-off.

Elaine: I pulled a quick list — 12 affected invoices (IDs masked in doc). Of those, 8 are committed prepay, 4 are usage-billed. For committed ones we should probably amortize reversal over remaining term; usage ones should be reversed immediately.

Maria: Putting proposed sample JEs here for accounting to review:
```
Dr Revenue Deferral (2100) 42,300
  Cr Vendor Accrual / Liability (2200) 42,300

Later, when vendor pays:
Dr Vendor Accrual (2200) 42,300
  Cr Cash / Bank (1000) 42,300

And for invoices already recognized (usage): reverse revenue immediately:
Dr Revenue (4000) 12,300
  Cr Revenue Deferral (2100) 12,300
```

Ajay: That approach matches policy. For committed subscriptions, set the deferral adjustment across the remaining term, not backdate. Tag these JEs with memo "pricing experiment reversal - CloudRack" and attach the vendor invoice. Please route for approval to Finance lead before EOD close. Also cc accounting@redwood.com. :eyes:

billing-bot: Reminder — month close lock is 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. Any unposted JEs will roll to next period.

Noah: I'll draft the adjusting entries and route them. @Maria please confirm vendor PO and ETA for payment so accrual timing is correct.

Maria: Vendor PO 83821, payment ETA 2024-12-08. I'll upload vendor confirmation to Confluence and ping you when it's in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
